summary.en: The screen changes state while the device stays: the next capture rises like the next post of a feed, the page is flicked to its next stop, or the whole device turns once; then the copy group lands.
summary.zh: 设备不动、屏幕换状态：下一张截图像信息流的下一条那样升上来、页面被甩到下一个停点，或整台设备翻转一次；然后文案组落定。

fits: A change of surface (the official page after the app) or of stop on the same page.
notFor: More than one flip a film; a cross-dissolve between states.

intent.en: The device stays the through-line while the evidence changes under the glass.
intent.zh: 设备始终是贯穿线索，证据在玻璃下更换。

content.en: The capture before and the capture after (or two stops of one long capture), each with its source line; the copy group as in screen-push.
content.zh: 换之前和之后的截图（或一张长截图上的两个停点），各带来源行；文案组同 screen-push。

fits.zh: 换一个画面（应用之后的官方页面），或同一页换一个停点。

notFor.zh: 一支片翻转超过一次；状态之间交叉淡化。

en: Flip once a film at most; change surface with a feed.
The chin must change with the screen (half way through a feed, on the flip’s swap frame).
zh: 一支片最多翻转一次；换画面用升起。
下巴要随屏幕换（升起到一半、翻转的切换帧）。

source.path: assets/templates/handset/choreo.js (TYPES.feed, scroll, flip), moves.js (feed-stack, scroll-reel, device-flip adapters)

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
